reviews.author: Allisen Giordano
reviews.text: Love Vero Beach Pediatrics and was excited when they notified their patient's families that they were opening an adult medicine side.  Immediately made an appointment with Dr. Stewart at Vero Beach Adult Medicine.  She was even better than I hoped!  Glad I made the switch for my PCP.

reviews.author: Shelly Hinkle
reviews.text: Dr. Stewart makes you feel seen and heard.  One of the best providers in the area.

reviews.author: Casey O'Neal
reviews.text: Love how friendly all the staff are and how much time Dr. Stewart takes with me.

reviews.author: Cassandra Ciriclio
reviews.text: Amazing staff and team. Relieved to have a Dr and staff at this office. I love that they have the pediatrics right next door!

reviews.author: Jillian Conway
reviews.text: Friendly office from the front desk to the doctor. I felt heard and I was given the time I needed with the doctor.

reviews.author: Chet Devarney
reviews.text: Great office.  They are friendly and listen to your concerns.

reviews.author: Tiffany
reviews.text: Every single staff member from start to finish was phenomenal. Very kind, very personable, very accepting. Dr. Stewart is exceptional, kind, understanding, patient, and knowledgeable with patient care.

reviews.author: Misha Whidden
reviews.text: Doctor Stewart was thorough and I felt very comfortable with her. Jennifer was knowledgeable and friendly. Summer was professional and super nice. Great experience !

reviews.author: Gg Gl
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable, Very Atentive , Very Experienced Doctor

reviews.author: Emily L.
reviews.text: I haven’t had a primary in decades but now that I’m getting older, I felt it was time to get established somewhere. It’s very refreshing to finally find a doctor that takes the time to get to know you! Dr. Stewart was so pleasant, listened to my concerns and requests, and made suggestions for other things we need to look at. I’m excited to work with her and her team in the future.

reviews.author: Lori Changas
reviews.text: Caring staff that takes time to get to know you. Today was my first visit and Dr. Stewart and staff were pleasant and attentive.

reviews.author: Lynn Hailey
reviews.text: Very friendly staff. Dr. Stewart is awesome.

reviews.author: Tiffany McLaughlin
reviews.text: Dr. Stewart is amazing. I felt welcomed and cared for at my first appointment, which lasted an hour. They took the time to hear everything I was concerned or had questions about, made recommendations and gave advice without being pushy on what I should choose, and ordered some extra blood tests to try to figure things out. After going almost a decade of never really feeling like I could find a doctor who thought all my “little, random” issues were worthy of being heard, I finally found one with Dr. Stewart!

reviews.author: Ryan Victory
reviews.text: Awesome new building space! Right next to the Pediatric office for easy scheduling.

reviews.author: Shannon Conn
reviews.text: Dr Stewart was amazing. I’m a first impression kinda person and her practice, although brand new, was very comfortable and inviting. Her staff was very kind as was she. After having to leave my previous primary care doctor (of many years) due to insurance change, I’m no longer stressed about it and so thankful to have found her.
